title: Bring your competition day together
description: Add camera cards. Your originals stay in place.

title: See the whole selection
description: Review suggested categories, scores and groups. The final decision is yours.

title: Inspect the details
description: Read focus, exposure and camera settings. Keep, Maybe and Reject stay within reach.
keys: K  Keep    M  Maybe    R  Reject

title: Give each frame room
description: Open the large view to inspect framing, then move between photos with the arrow keys.

title: Compare before you decide
description: Put similar frames side by side. Look at the subject, not just the score.

title: Check the destination and totals
description: All categories are copied into organized folders. Originals are never moved or deleted.

title: Your selection, ready for the next step
description: Open the organized folder or return to your saved review.
